observed_behavior: Each certificate path launched a separate Git process; Gwen used 4,893 object processes in one scan.
expected_behavior: Reuse unchanged relevant inputs without repeated per-path process overhead or inactive-input invalidation.
causal_mechanism: Object inspection cost scaled with path occurrences through repeated synchronous process startup.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Object inspection cost scaled with path occurrences through repeated synchronous process startup.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Unchanged index updates repeat work unrelated to changed active evidence.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Current freshness results remain complete and isolated by scope; inactive evidence cannot affect active projection.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Batch object checks and share index comparisons by revision plus one working-tree and untracked inspection per pass.

applicability_conditions: A growing certificate history with overlapping Git input scopes.
known_non_matches: An actual active-input change must still invalidate cached assessment.
confirmation_evidence: Git trace regression: 43 object commands before batching; one after.
regression_proofs: tests/obligations.test.ts: Git input existence checks batch many paths and preserve unusual missing names
tests/obligations.test.ts: shared Git inspection isolates scopes, preserves staged restoration and refreshes each invocation
